title: TileSetEditor's tile edit area strangely change it's size(the upper boundary is not aligned) in some conditions
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.1stable ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7628) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12490F (12 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory ### Issue description My issue title may not be well chosen because it's not easy to describe the issue simply. Below, I will provide a detailed description of the specific phenomenon of the problem. The size of the tile editing area on the right side of the TileSetEditor changes unexpectedly under specific circumstances, manifesting as the upper boundary repeatedly jumping. This issue occurs in the following scenarios: - In the Atlas Setup panel, the upper boundary of the erase tool is misaligned with the upper boundary of the left-side atlas panel. It only aligns when right-clicking a tile, but becomes misaligned again after deleting a tile. - If you first select the Select panel, click on any single tile, and then switch back to the Setup panel, the upper boundary on the right side aligns correctly. However, if you click on multiple tiles in the Select panel and then switch back to the Setup panel, the upper boundary becomes misaligned. Additionally, deleting any tile at any point will revert the boundary to the misaligned state. _The following video and screenshot can make it easier to understand the issue._ Screenshot: Demo: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2be9f33a-7524-4a1f-b593-5744e7534c4d ### Steps to reproduce N/A ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
